Chapter 6027: Buddha’S Beginning, Fiend’S End

Chapter 6027: Buddha’s Beginning, Fiend’s End

“Clank!” Allmountain, Omni, Buddha Fiend, and Winged-serpent felt an incoming thrust attempting to piece their throat.

Only the glint of the spear was left in this colorless world.

“Mountain Immortal!” Allmountain roared and utilized his primal affinity in the forms of divine rings. A majestic figure of an immortal appeared amidst the radiance, seemingly possessing him and granting him immense power.

“Unrivalled Monarch!” Omni knew who was coming for them instantly.

“Omni-dragon!” He focused on defense and created a scaled armor made from various affinities. The golden scales seemed to be coming from a true dragon. They had draconic runes and contained the mysteries of this race.

“Inexhaustible Specter Domain!” Buddha Fiend felt a sharp pain in his throat and released all of his vitality and sacred fruits.

The anima tree summoned three thousand Buddhas first. They formed mudras and started chanting to create a realm of countless ghosts and fiends.

These apparitions joined together to form a supreme specter monarch. It roared menacingly and attempted to stop the spear.

“Break!” The one who felt threatened the most was Winged-serpent, flapping his wings forward and releasing a treasure wheel.

“Indestructible Wheel!” He chose the temporal affinity with his wheel to stop the thrust.

“Rumble!” Allmountain successfully stopped the thrust.

Omni’s domain was broken but his draconic armor blocked it successfully.

Another thrust pierced through the specter monarch and other defenses. This bought Buddha Fiend enough time to retreat but a wound could be seen on his neck.

Winged-serpent was not so lucky. His treasure wheel looked as feeble as paper and shattered instantly. The spear pierced him and vibrated, reducing him to a bloody mist before he could scream.

“Bam!” The barrages ended with the physical spear pinning the ground, causing Splendor Terra to shake violently.

A peerless beauty picked up the spear, fully intimidating the crowd. No wonder why no one dared to attack Splendor Terra all this time. She alone had the upper hand against four powerful cultivators.

“Monarch!” Buddha Fiend was shocked to see her.

Allmountain and Omni readied their weapons and treasures, preparing to fight.

“Clank!” She raised her spear again, aiming for Buddha Fiend. The resplendent thrust pierced through dimensions while showing no mercy, pinning dao laws to the ground and causing them to lament.

“Buddha’s Beginning, Fiends’ End!” Buddha Fiend bellowed the name of his most powerful attack, summoning a Buddhist kingdom with a corrosive affinity.

“Pluff!” The kingdom and its evil affinity were pierced instantly. Buddha Fiend’s eyes were wide open before death, unable to accept his demise.

“Bam!” His corpse fell backward and the ground became stained with blood.

The scene fell into silence and the next breeze caused everyone to tremble. Her cold expression forced the crowd to drop to the ground.

They didn’t prepare sufficiently against her rage. Her murderous intent surged like that of a wrathful dragon and engulfed all of Splendor Terra. Desolate gods and emperors no longer felt safe.

Few in the crowd were stronger than Buddha Fiend and Winged-serpent yet they got killed instantly.

Omni was a half-step apex cultivator but he could tell the gap between them. As for Allmountain, he was one of the strongest emperors in Sin. He had a serious expression while staring at the opponent.

“Your death is justified.” She raised her spear at them.
